reason: A offers the cleaner, physically defensible hypothesis: composition-matched multilayer and monolithic coatings directly test whether coherent/misfit interfaces suppress dislocation-mediated creep, with explicit boundaries and falsification. B adds poorly supported claims that interfaces impede diffusion and that a universal “sluggish diffusion effect” raises creep activation energy—interfaces can instead be fast-diffusion paths—and its cited evidence does not establish those claims.
